method: Worker B, same AI, separately identified source-first pass. Reopened the underlying dated curriculum, ALF skills entries, practice pathways, integration course, open-choice rules and thesis entry requirements before reconsidering the exact finished UCR selections and placements from current workbook evidence. Read the final reader-facing fields and selected descriptions using the established renderer mapping. This is analytical separation by the same AI, not an independent person or live rendering.
findings: The dated guide and current degree page confirm the generic Dutch full-time Law LLB, recognized 50700, without a formal chosen route. There are ten six-credit units in each earlier year; Year 3 has thirty-three common, six restricted, six thesis and fifteen open credits. Twenty-nine credit-bearing components total 180 uniquely. Retained Insolvency from the original public-list order; the dated menu permits either Insolvency or Labour, its reverse listing does not establish a different default. Neither is a formal route and both are not added.

Four zero-credit Amsterdam Law Firm modules are mandatory. They develop case-based legal research, sources, writing, defence, advocacy and mediation alongside substantive subjects. The second-year research plan must score at least five before the report; the second-year moot court is concurrent with the appropriate substantive/procedural law. Completing all earlier subjects meets the actual course entry and advisory foundations. No numeric progression threshold is invented where the entry requires programme enrolment.

The original practice description was too broad. Its dated course has two actual pathways; the finished record explicitly chooses the legal-case mediation/negotiation simulation. It does not invent a clinic, host or internship. The separate internship-only conditions, minimum thirty hours and approval/date requirements are not misapplied to the simulation. The choice supports a bounded negotiation-method relationship rather than pretending that every communication course supplies legal practice.

Thesis entry is 120 EC already registered in SIS three weeks before semester start. Expected unregistered grades do not count. Completing both earlier years establishes that minimum before the selected Spring thesis. The course includes an individual legal paper, research-plan stages and presentation/defence before two assessors. Fiscal topic access is not assumed without the fiscal minor, and no particular topic is guaranteed. The fifteen-credit space remains open for approved electives, a minor or exchange without a named host.

All sixty-four exact-target interest rows are reconciled: twelve generators, thirty-four support topics, six illustrations and twelve outcomes. Corrected digitalisation’s false reference to criminal-law row 20010; the actual official Digitalisation entry supports that topic. The closest broad legal/social response and public/international and commercial priorities remain coherent. Career or professional-status outcomes are not turned into entitlements.

The closest UCR response now retains substantial comparative/private/criminal/constitutional/rights/EU/international legal study and adds transnational legal transactions, business foundations and AI governance in place of generic history/persuasion/civil-society selections. The public option strengthens criminal justice, ethics and policy rather than relying on military or generic research history. The commercial option adds criminal liability instead of civil-society theory. Complementary politics, finance, economic and empirical methods implement defined concepts; they are not misrepresented as missing Dutch doctrines. Pairwise differences are thirty-seven-and-a-half, sixty-seven-and-a-half and ninety EC each way with sustained qualitative differences.

All selected course contributions are reconsidered from actual profiles or descriptions, including description-only strategy, market research, econometrics and public-policy analysis. Four original offering conflicts are repaired. Actual earlier prerequisites and offerings, twenty-four unique courses, four per term, first-year PPD and six advanced courses all pass. Microeconomics before Public Economics was tested and infeasible under current terms and the earlier-methods rule; it is placed concurrently where selected, after introductory economics and statistics, without creating an extra formal gate.

Thirteen positive placements concern important legal subjects or substantive methods, with scope differences explicit. Public international law is placed directly with that subject, substantive criminal law with substantive liability, transnational contracts with obligations, and negotiation with the chosen mediation/negotiation pathway. Sixteen components retain meaningful gaps. In particular company-law doctrine, insolvency doctrine, dedicated procedures, legal history and the compulsory thesis are not replaced by adjacent business, finance, general history or generic research. Optional independent research is separate from scheduled credits.

Read the exact finished English Law title, twenty-nine component labels, eight notes, three concepts, thirteen relationships, sixteen gaps and thirty-seven selected descriptions. All audience references and links resolve correctly; current reviewed input hashes are recorded. Reused unchanged shared descriptions while reassessing their specific course-to-concept contribution. No app/renderer, workbook or enrichment changes, local Shiny/browser launch, screenshots, live modal or release approval are claimed.
